summary: Novartis AG filed a Form 6-K reporting positive Phase I/II clinical trial results for delpacibart braxlosiran in facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy. The filing discloses no corporate transaction, no change in control, no capital restructuring, and no special-situation event. It is a routine foreign private issuer report of operational and scientific progress with no M&A, financing, or governance implications. The press release discusses biomarker and safety data, regulatory engagement plans, and pipeline updates from a prior acquisition of Avidity Biosciences completed in February 2026, which is historical and not the subject of this filing. As a standard clinical update under Rule 13a-16, this fits no special-situations category.
